title: AJK Election Phase 1: PML-N Wins 9 of 13 Mirpur Division Seats
detail: The first phase of the 45-seat Azad Jammu & Kashmir Legislative Assembly election was held in the Mirpur division, with PML-N winning 9 of 13 constituencies according to preliminary results, and PPP and independents splitting the remainder. Polling proceeded under heavy security amid scuffles, violence, and mutual accusations of rigging between PML-N and PPP. The vote is the first since the AJK Supreme Court's June ruling upholding the 12 refugee-reserved seats that triggered weeks of deadly JAAC-led unrest; the Joint Awami Action Committee urged a boycott of the election, and mobile/internet services remained suspended across much of the territory, with Poonch division sealed off for weeks ahead of later polling phases.

media.caption: Voting in Azad Jammu and Kashmir's first election phase amid tight security and JAAC calls for a boycott

title: Pakistan Monsoon Death Toll Tops 100 as Floods Spread
detail: Pakistan's monsoon-related death toll since June 26 passed 100, reaching 107 killed and 344 injured according to the National Disaster Management Authority, with Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (55 deaths) and Punjab (46 deaths) the hardest hit provinces. More than half of the fatalities were caused by house or roof collapses. The Federal Emergency Response Committee put departments on high alert ahead of a forecast fresh spell of heavy rain from July 29–August 5; rescuers had carried out 130 operations over the preceding month, evacuating nearly 4,000 people.

media.caption: Flooded streets following monsoon rains in Pakistan as the nationwide death toll passes 100
